Name: Custom NPC Ivaras
Author: starfyzz
Description:
[center][b][size=5]About Ivaras Wolfgang[/size][/b][/center]

[quote]He is a young man trying his best to succeed in his arcane pursuits, even when the odds are against him. Acting as Rasmodius’ apprentice, Ivaras is often found within the tower and the surrounding forest. After their first meeting, he finds himself longing for a visit from his favorite farmer as the seasons pass and his affections grow.[/quote]﻿
[center][b][size=5]About the Mod[/size][/b][/center]

This mod includes most everything that comes with a standard bachelor in the vanilla game, such as:

[list]
[*]An event at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 14 hearts[/*]
[*]Numerous animations and portraits[/*]
[*]Plentiful marriage dialogue, as well as a spouse room and patio[/*]
[*]A schedule for each season that varies depending on the day of the week, rain/green rain, the Night Market, and marriage[/*]
[*]Responses to each movie[/*]
[*]Festival inclusions, but note that he will NOT be present at the Egg Festival, the Desert Festival, Winter Star Feast, or the Luau due to it not making sense for him to be there (this may change for the Desert Festival in future updates)[/*]
[*]Children with his hair color[/*]
[/list]I recommend starting from a new save after downloading this mod. This mod is 1.6 compatible. I also recommend playing the ten-heart event BEFORE getting married, but, by all means, play it how you like :)

[left][b][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher and Smapi[/*]
[*]This mod is NOT compatible with SVE or any other mod that makes big changes to the game, especially those that majorly change the Wizard tower interior or the Wizard’s schedule in any way.[/*]
[/list][left][size=3][b]More Info:[/b][/size][/left]

[b][i]Schedule:[/i][/b]
[code][spoiler]
Keep in mind that he may be walking to said locations right at the time changes. This may be updated in the future so make sure to check back in after a new release.

Spring, Mon, Wed, Sun:
6 AM - 1 PM: Wizard Tower
1 PM - 5:30 PM: Cindersap Forest, near the hat mouse
5:30 PM onward: in his room

Tuesdays, all seasons:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower until bedtime

Thursdays, all seasons:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower until bedtime

Fridays:
6 AM - 8:10 AM: in the Wizard tower
8:10 AM - 1 PM: on the dock over the Cindersap Forest pond
1 PM - 5:30 PM: near the traveling cart
5:30 PM onward: in his room

Saturdays:
6 AM - 3 PM: various locations within the Wizard Tower
3 PM - 6:30 PM: on the dock over the Cindersap Forest pond
6:30 PM onward: in his room

Summer, Mon, Wed, Sun:
6 AM - 9 AM: various locations within the Wizard Tower
9 AM - 3 PM: southern tip of the small island south of Leah’s cabin (where you catch the Glacierfish)
3 PM - 7:30 PM: in his room

Fall, Mon, Wed, Sun:
6:30 AM - 7:30 AM PM: in the Wizard Tower
7:30 AM - 10:30 AM: by the pink tree in the Cindersap Forest
10:30 PM - 3 PM: on the dock over the Cindersap Forest pond
3 PM Onward: in the Wizard tower

Winter, Mon, Wed, Sun:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower

Winter 16 (Night Market Day 2):
6 AM - 3 PM: various locations within the Wizard Tower
3 PM - 10 PM: standing by the free coffee lady on the dock
10 PM onward: walking back to the tower

Rain:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower
[/spoiler][/code]
